name: ACA 521 滑行道障碍 机长心脏病

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 521, a flight from Wuhan to Toronto, you are at gate 232, you have got the latest ATIS Tango, contact Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 521，从 Wuhan 到 Toronto，位于 232 号登机口，已收到最新 ATIS Tango，联系武汉放行请求 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, ACA521, gate 232, information T, request ATC clearance to Toronto.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，ACA521，232 号登机口，信息 T，请求前往 Toronto 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb to 1500 meters, Zulu Foxtrot 05 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，可以按计划航路前往 Toronto，离场跑道 04，初始爬升到 1500 米，Zulu Foxtrot 05 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，途中请求高度变更，离场频率 125.75，应答机 5655。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb to 1500 meters, ZF 05 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Toronto，离场跑道 04，初始爬升到 1500 米，ZF 05 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，途中请求高度变更，离场频率 125.75，应答机 5655，ACA521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已完成推出和开车，准备滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA521, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA521，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha, hold short of Echo 5.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 Echo 5 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 E5 前等待，ACA521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you see there is an obstruction ahead of you on taxiway Alpha 3, you confirm the taxi instructions with Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你看到前方滑行道 Alpha 3 上有障碍物，向武汉地面确认滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA521, there is an obstruction ahead of us on A3, confirm the taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA521，A3 上我们前方有障碍物，请确认滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, hold at present position, the ground handling will deal with it.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，原地等待，地面保障会处理。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, the obstruction has been removed, continue taxi via Alpha 3, Alpha to holding point runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，障碍物已移除，继续经 Alpha 3、Alpha 滑行至跑道 04 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via A3, A to holding point runway 04, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经 A3、A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，ACA521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point Echo 5 runway 04, you are fully ready, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 04 Echo 5 等待点等待，完全准备好，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA521, holding at holding point E5 runway 04, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA521，在跑道 04 E5 等待点等待，完全准备好。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, line up and cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04, surface wind 030 degrees, 8 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，进跑道并立即起飞，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，地面风 030 度 8 节。
cards.referenceText: Line up and cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道并立即起飞，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，ACA521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, you are passing 1200 meters, climbing to 2400 meters, make an initial contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已离地，正通过 1200 米，爬升到 2400 米，与 Wuhan Departure 建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA521, passing 1200 meters, climbing to 2400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA521，通过 1200 米，爬升到 2400 米。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, radar contact, turn right, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, climb to 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，雷达识别，右转，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，爬升到 4500 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, climb to 4500 meters, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，爬升到 4500 米，ACA521。

cards.audioText: B: Your TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o'clock, 300 meters above your level, confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有冲突交通，在你高度上方 300 米，向武汉管制确认是否与你的飞机冲突。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA521, our TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o'clock, 300 meters above our level, is it in conflict with us ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA521，我们的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有冲突交通，在我们高度上方 300 米，是否与我们冲突？

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, negative, it is parallel to your flight track.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，否，它与你的航迹平行。

cards.audioText: B: During cruise, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, make an Urgency call to Wuhan Control and request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 巡航期间，机长突然心脏病发作，向武汉管制发出紧急呼叫并请求立即返航优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA521, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA521，机长突然心脏病发作，请求立即返航优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 521, roger PAN PAN, turn left heading 220, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, descend to 3300 meters, you are number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 521，收到 PANPAN，左转航向 220，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，下降到 3300 米，你是第 1 架。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300 meters, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，直飞 ZF，下降到 3300 米，ACA521。

cards.audioText:
C: Air Canada 521, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need an ambulance and a physician.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 521，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要救护车和医生。
cards.referenceText: Request an ambulance and a physician, ACA521.
